name: Default
shortDescription: Web UI for managing Traefik routes, middlewares, services, certificates and logs, with agents that manage Traefik on remote servers.

alerts.message: The first login password is printed once in the container logs under AUTO-GENERATED PASSWORD; the setup wizard then asks for a permanent one.

This deployment does not control the server's own reverse proxy. Point it at a Traefik API you can reach, or run the Traefik Manager Agent next to each remote Traefik and add it under Settings - Agents.
